assessment.strategicOverview: Blind A forms a more believable graduated woodland edge, with irregular low-to-medium clumps and clearer negative space around the settlement instead of a comparatively uniform wall of mature crowns and trunks.
assessment.settlementReadability: Roads, plots, roofs, fields, and the clearing boundary remain immediately readable in Blind A.
assessment.closeRoute: The close road frames are equivalently readable; the intended difference is concentrated at the settlement-to-forest transition rather than introducing distracting near-camera geometry.
assessment.performance: Both blind arms passed the sealed absolute performance bar, so the preference is not trading visual quality for a measured frame-time regression.
